title: What is InterChat?
summary: A faith-based messaging and community app for connecting, praying and growing together.
text: InterChat is a faith-based messaging and community app, built so Christians (and anyone exploring the faith) can connect, pray and grow together. summary: What you need to sign up, and why we ask for your date of birth.
text: Creating an InterChat account takes a couple of minutes. Open the app and tap Sign up . Enter your email address or phone number. Enter the verification code we send you. summary: Delete for yourself, or for everyone — and what each one leaves behind.
text: You can only delete messages you sent yourself. There are two ways to do it: Delete for me. Removes the message from your own view only. Everyone else in the chat still sees it. summary: Sent, delivered and read — and how to turn off read receipts.
text: The ticks next to your messages show their status: whether a message has been sent, delivered to the other person's device, and read. Read receipts are a setting you control. title: Muting a chat or community
summary: Stop the notifications without leaving — @mentions still get through.
text: If a chat or community is busy and you need some quiet, you can mute it instead of leaving. Swipe left on the chat or community in your Chats list and tap Mute , or open its info screen and mute it from there. title: Drafts
summary: Unsent messages are saved on your phone automatically.
text: If you start typing a message and leave the chat before sending it, InterChat keeps it as a draft so you don't lose your train of thought. summary: Respond to a specific message without losing the thread.
text: In a busy chat or community, it helps to respond to a specific message rather than just adding a new one at the bottom. Reply to a message to quote it, so it's clear what you're responding to. summary: Owners, admins and moderators keep a community running well.

summary: Share a need, even anonymously, and let others respond that they've prayed.
text: You can share a prayer request in a community or on the Prayer Wall, and others can respond with "I prayed" to let you know they've lifted it up, or post an update once it's answered. summary: Ask your community a question and see how people vote.
text: Polls let you ask a quick question in a chat or community and see how people respond, without everyone needing to reply individually. summary: Admins can pin a message so it stays easy to find.
text: Admins can pin an important message in a community — a meeting time, a welcome note, or anything worth keeping easy to find above the regular flow of chat. title: What is a Prayer Room?
summary: A live voice gathering inside a community, where members take turns to pray.
text: A Prayer Room is a live voice gathering inside a community, where members can pray together out loud, one at a time. summary: You join muted, raise your hand to pray, then unmute when it's your turn.
text: When you join a Prayer Room, you join muted by default, so the room stays calm and focused as people arrive. To pray out loud: Raise your hand ✋ to let the host know you'd like to pray. summary: Mute, manage turns, remove someone, or end the room.

title: Scheduling a Prayer Room
summary: Plan one ahead, reply Going or Can't make it, and add it to your calendar.
text: Rather than starting a Prayer Room on the spot, you can schedule one ahead of time so your community knows when to show up. title: Prayer Rooms aren't recorded
summary: InterChat doesn't record them, and you shouldn't either.
text: Prayer Rooms are not recorded by InterChat . They're live voice gatherings, connected through our calling provider, and nothing said in them is stored by us afterwards. summary: Three daily goals keep your streak alive — reading, prayer and the Prayer Wall.
text: Your prayer streak counts the days you've shown up consistently for your own time with God. A day counts toward your streak when you complete all three of these: Read today's verse (the Verse of the Day). Finish a guided prayer. Pray for someone on the Prayer Wall. summary: Only shared verses, quotes, sermons, podcasts and reading plans count.
text: A faith streak is a streak you keep together with one friend, rather than on your own. title: Reading the Bible offline
summary: Chapters you've read are saved for offline reading, where the publisher allows it.
text: InterChat saves the chapters you've recently read on your phone, so you can keep reading them without an internet connection. summary: Audio Bibles, sermons, podcasts and worship music, all inside the app.
text: Beyond reading, InterChat lets you listen to audio Bibles, sermons, podcasts and worship music, wherever you are. title: Posting a story
summary: Share a text, photo or video story — visible for 24 hours.
text: A story is a text, photo or video update that's visible to others for a limited time, rather than staying in your profile permanently. title: Hiding or reporting someone's stories
summary: Quietly stop seeing them, or report one that breaks the guidelines.
text: If you'd rather not see a particular person's stories, you can hide or mute their stories without blocking or unfollowing them outright — they won't know you've done it. summary: Call someone directly from a chat — needs a working internet connection.
text: You can start a voice or video call directly from a chat with someone on InterChat. Calls are connected through our calling provider and need a working internet connection — they'll use mobile data if you're not on Wi-Fi, so it's worth being mindful of your data plan for longer calls. summary: Android 14 full-screen permission, and extra settings on some phones.
text: If a call or Prayer Room doesn't ring with a full-screen alert the way you'd expect, it's usually a phone setting rather than a problem with InterChat. title: Quiet hours
summary: Pause notifications for a set time each day, set on your device.
text: Quiet hours let you pause InterChat's notifications for a period you choose, so they don't interrupt you — overnight, for example, or during a set time of day. Quiet hours are a setting kept on your device. When they're on, routine notifications are held back until quiet hours end. If you've set up

title: Muting with @mention exceptions
summary: Muted chats stay quiet, except when someone @mentions you directly.
text: Muting a chat or community stops its routine notifications, but InterChat makes one exception: if someone @mentions you by name, you'll still be notified, even though the rest of the chat is muted. This means you can mute a busy community to cut down the noise, without worrying that you'll miss some

title: Blocking someone
summary: Stops them contacting you or seeing your content — and it works both ways.
text: If you'd rather not have any contact with someone on InterChat, you can block them. Open their profile. Tap ⋯ → Block . Blocking works both ways : once you've blocked someone, neither of you can message, call or see each other's profile, stories or activity. Blocking doesn't notify the other person.

title: Reporting and what happens next
summary: How to report, what we do about it, and how to appeal.
text: You can report almost anything on InterChat straight from where you see it: A message: long-press it → Report . A person: open their profile → ⋯ → Report (you can also Block them). A community: Community info → Report community . A story: ⋯ → Report story . A prayer request or comment: ⋮ → Report .

title: Who can see your profile
summary: You control your photo, bio, last-seen and stories — your name and username are always visible.
text: Your username and name are always visible to other InterChat users, so people can find and recognise you. Beyond that, you control who sees: Your profile photo Your bio Your last-seen time Your stories Whether you send read receipts You can change any of these at any time from your privacy settings.

title: Is InterChat end-to-end encrypted?
summary: No. Messages are encrypted in transit, but not end-to-end.
text: Honestly: no, InterChat is not end-to-end encrypted. Everything sent between the app and our servers is encrypted in transit (TLS), so it's protected from being intercepted on the way. title: Avoiding scams
summary: Never send money for "prayer fees" or to someone you haven't verified.
text: Sadly, scammers sometimes target faith communities. InterChat has zero tolerance for this, but it helps to know what to watch for. title: Child safety on InterChat
summary: Zero tolerance for child exploitation, and how to report it.
text: InterChat has zero tolerance for child sexual abuse and exploitation. Protecting children is part of who we are as a faith community. InterChat is for people aged 13 and older, and we delete any account we find belongs to someone under 13. Adults must not seek private, secretive or romantic contact

text: InterChat Plus is billed through the Apple App Store or Google Play, so refunds are handled by them under their own policies, rather than by InterChat directly. summary: A few quick things to try before contacting us.

title: A link didn't open the app
summary: What happens when you tap an InterChat link, depending on your phone.
text: InterChat links — like an invite ( interchathq.com/join/… ), a profile ( interchathq.com/profile/… ) or a Prayer Room link — are designed to open directly in the app. What actually happens depends on your phone: App installed and verified: the link opens the app directly; the website isn't involved.

title: Using less data
summary: Calls, Prayer Rooms and media are the biggest users of mobile data.
